title: Closed extraordinary restriction commutes with finite direct image
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $p:X'\to X$ be a finite morphism of Noetherian schemes and $i:Y\hookrightarrow X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Form $Y'=Y\times_X X'$ with projections $i':Y'\hookrightarrow X'$ and $p':Y'\to Y$, and put $q=pi'=ip'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. On ordinary small-etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], use the bounded-below right adjoints $i^!,i'^!$ to exact closed direct image, and exact finite direct images $p_*,p'_*,q_*$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. There is a natural isomorphism
$$i^!p_*M\cong p'_*i'^!M\qquad(M\in D^+(X'_{\mathrm{et}},A)).$$
Under $i^!i_*\cong\mathrm{id}$ and this isomorphism, the map
$$i^!\bigl(p_*i'_*i'^!M\longrightarrow p_*M\bigr)$$
obtained from the counit for $i'$ is the identity of $p'_*i'^!M$. In particular it is an isomorphism. The exchange uses the canonical pullback/closed-direct-image base-change map and the ordinary adjunctions; the displayed normalization fixes the counit map, rather than merely asserting that its source and target are isomorphic.
